name: owned-outright
description: US mortgage payoff maths from ownedoutright.com. Gives the new payoff date and interest saved from extra payments, the extra needed to be mortgage-free by a date, when a refinance breaks even, when PMI can be removed, and ARM payments with the worst case the caps allow. Education only, not financial advice.

interface.longDescription: US mortgage maths from ownedoutright.com. Give ChatGPT your balance, rate and time left. It works out the new payoff date and the interest saved from a monthly, yearly or one-time extra payment, the extra needed to be mortgage-free by a date, or how many months until a refinance pays for its closing costs. It can also work out when PMI can be cancelled or must end on a conventional loan, and the payments on an adjustable-rate mortgage, including the highest payment its rate caps allow. Every answer links to the matching calculator so you can adjust the numbers. Education only, not financial advice.
capabilities: Calculate mortgage payoff with extra payments
Find the extra payment needed for a payoff date
Find when PMI can be removed
Show ARM payments and the worst case
